problem: A configurable extension host is incomplete when its definition type is added without the same owner-owned value lifecycle, generated contract, form input, durable readback, formal fixture coverage, and every approved detail read projection as existing hosts. A protected operations endpoint is also incomplete when its generated requirement exists only in edge metadata or a session snapshot rather than a live owner capability recheck and first-owner-query scope predicate. A legal business-entity search or presentation request is incomplete when the owner attributes exist but only one app, one projection, or one segment of the request path exposes them. An administrator credential-reset command is incomplete when it creates a secret that no approved delivery or UI route can consume, leaves the prior credential usable, or relies on a client redirect rather than an owner-enforced credential state.
rootCauseLayer: cross-layer extension-host completeness and capability-to-owner-command execution, including an earlier metadata model that could represent capability on workspace read operations despite Dexter's role-node-only read-scope rule; the operations audit reader additionally treated page admission, UI-selected data node and role-node range denial as session invalidation instead of deriving each audit host's primary-object scope through the organization owner task path. The business-entity overview family also had a split read model: operations declared legal filters in OpenAPI but dropped them at UI/controller/owner predicate, while platform's independent owner task projection and contract never carried legal fields. The credential-reset defect is a product-to-owner state-machine gap: the earlier implementation retained a legacy generation-key model after its delivery/entry path disappeared, so neither persistence nor the normal operations session boundary expressed a mandatory credential transition.
finiteApplicabilityDenominator: 9 operations audit entity types across 6 audit-modal hosts
BUSINESS_ENTITY: BRAND, TENANT, HEAD_COMPANY across both platform-admin overview and operations-admin management
legal-entity filter and presentation paths: operations UI -> operations edge -> organization owner; platform UI -> platform edge -> organization overview owner -> generated contract

workspace-IAM administrator reset command, credential persistence, password and OTP login, session entry, protected operations-session resolver, current-password update, anonymous operations recovery, platform account command UI, operations forced-password UI, old resetGenerationKey public OpenAPI/controller/generated-client/test/schema paths
counterexampleBoundary: Existing hosts retain their current owners and UI paths; the 20 invitation/assignment mutations already enforce equivalent owner action and scope checks. The 20 workspace-IAM reads deliberately have no read capability: their primary-object visibility remains role-node-range based, while associated facts and relation-constrained candidates are not secondarily scope-filtered. The four self-session operations are bearer-session facts, not task-scope actions. For legal entity presentation, TENANT and HEAD_COMPANY carry legalName/unifiedSocialCreditCode; BRAND is the explicit counterexample and stays name/code-only. The anonymous operations self-service recovery stays separate: it verifies login-name, matching mobile and OTP before setting a user-chosen password, and therefore clears the mandatory-change state. Platform-administrator credential reset is a different owner and remains untouched. This package neither introduces a generic cross-owner value writer nor changes unrelated organization types.
minimalRepair: Extend the existing definition/value model at the owning commercial-group and hierarchy services, expose it through generated edge contracts, and reuse one operations organization-extension field renderer for region/project form and detail paths. Reuse the generated platform definition query to map the commercial-group root readback in the platform hierarchy; keep region/project detail mapping owner-side. Seed through owner HTTP commands and assert owner readback. For authorization, carry a typed server-resolved grant from workspace-IAM to the owner command/read API, live-recheck assignment/capability in workspace-IAM, and apply the owner predicate to the first target query before receipt replay and mutation. The read-only audit modal must use only its already-read host entity's actual task target and current role-node range through OrganizationTaskPathLookup; it must neither consume pageAccessKeys nor selected UI data-node state. Only a missing/invalid current role is 401; every valid-session host/range denial is typed 403 and never invokes browser session recovery. For legal entity reads, retain app-owned UI shells but make TENANT and HEAD_COMPANY legal-name/unified-code fields flow from the organization owner through each app's own contract, generated client, list/detail projection, and count-identical predicate; use the single user-facing term 统一代码 without renaming the durable API field. For credential reset, the workspace-IAM owner hashes the account's normalized login name as a temporary password, clears lock state, records a mandatory-change credential flag, revokes operations sessions and returns CHANGE_REQUIRED via owner readback. Password and OTP login both receive a restricted entry outcome; the common protected-session resolver rejects that state for all ordinary operations, while entry, current-password update and logout remain explicitly allowed. Operations-admin renders a non-dismissible centered mandatory-change page before role or shell selection; successful password change clears the flag and requires reauthentication. The old resetGenerationKey controller, public paths, generated public client operations, owner records and migrations are removed rather than retained as a second admin reset route.
preventionDestination: U26 focused owner/contract/codegen/UI tests cover all three hierarchy details; the fresh r5-full owner-command seed covers durable owner facts. The capability invariant gate receives a 66-operation execution reconciliation and focused stale-grant/first-query red mutations for workspace-IAM, organization and contract owners. It now also fails if a non-write OpenAPI operation, non-write registry requirement, or operations edge @GetMapping reintroduces capability resolution, including a typed resolver field alias or a same-controller private helper; its generator projects only write requirements into workspace-IAM capability catalogs. The audit service tests add pageAccess-empty, HEAD_COMPANY, role-node denial, invitation all-intent and invalid-current-role counterexamples; controller tests assert all nine entity dispatches use their actual host target types, including both REGION and PROJECT organization-node variants. BusinessEntityService and OrganizationOverviewTaskReadService focused tests must prove legalName/unifiedSocialCreditCode filters produce the same total and page predicate for TENANT and HEAD_COMPANY, with BRAND excluded; both app focused UI tests must prove requested filters and legal fields use their app-local generated clients. G-05A and the business-corpus adoption policy require human review to distinguish range-bound primary objects from unbounded associated facts and relationship-constrained candidates.
